upstream.description: Your personal voice interface for any app. Speak naturally and your words appear wherever your cursor is, with fully customizable AI voice dictation.  Open source alternative to Wispr Flow.

classification.analysis: Tambourine is an open-source, cross-platform (Windows/macOS) voice-dictation app: a global hotkey starts recording, a Rust/Tauri desktop client streams audio over WebRTC (Pipecat SmallWebRTC) to a local or self-hosted Python server, and an LLM cleans up the raw transcript (removing filler words, adding punctuation, applying a personal dictionary, and adapting formatting to the focused app) before typing it at the cursor. It's bring-your-own-key across many STT providers (Cartesia, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, Groq, etc.) and LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Cerebras, etc.), or fully local via Whisper/Faster-Whisper/MLX and Ollama, and is positioned as an open-source alternative to Wispr Flow and Superwhisper for people who want full control over their voice-to-text pipeline. Built on Pipecat's modular voice-agent pipeline; still under active development with a planned hosted service.

use_cases.title: Dictate text into any app on Windows or macOS with a global hotkey
Clean up raw speech transcripts with an LLM before they're typed
Run voice dictation fully offline with local Whisper and Ollama
Self-host a private, open-source alternative to Wispr Flow or Superwhisper
